periods.time: vol-11 ch-003 before the award ceremony

name.zh: 法米利昂皇国访问的决定

periods.summary: Before receiving their awards, Stella reminds Ikki that her father demanded he visit the Familion Empire after Seven Stars. She has already booked tickets for a week later and jokes that war may break out if he delays after taking a princess's chastity. Ikki can only agree to face her father and family.
periods.cause: Stella's father previously required Ikki to formally visit after the tournament, and Ikki and Stella's relationship has now advanced further.
periods.outcome: The next story stage is set as a visit to Stella's homeland and family.
periods.significance: Transitions the series from the Seven Stars arc to the Familion visit arc.
